item.title: St. Lucie County offering free rip current safety demonstrations at three pools this summer
item.description: St. Lucie County Parks & Recreation will host three free sessions using a rip current simulation machine to teach proper escape techniques in a controlled environment.

item.title: Jensen Beach Park concession building and restrooms to be rebuilt by late 2027
item.description: Jensen Beach Park beachgoers have been waiting for the rebuild of the park's restrooms and concession building since a fire destroyed them on New Year's Eve in December 2024.

item.title: US-Belgium World Cup match draws record 30 million viewers on Fox Sports
item.description: Monday's United States-Belgium World Cup match was the most-watched soccer telecast in U.S. history, with viewership peaking at 36 million during the second half.

item.title: United States eliminated from World Cup after 4-1 loss to Belgium in Seattle
item.description: Belgium knocked the U.S. out of the World Cup in the round of 16 for the second time in 12 years, winning 4-1 at Lumen Field as Charles De Ketelaere scored twice.

item.title: Lionel Messi leads Argentina to 3-2 comeback victory over Egypt in World Cup round of 16
item.description: Messi scored his eighth goal of the tournament and Argentina rallied from a two-goal deficit with 11 minutes left to defeat Egypt 3-2 and advance to the World Cup quarterfinals.

item.title: IOC ends neutral status vetting for Russian athletes ahead of 2028 Los Angeles Olympics
item.description: The International Olympic Committee advised Olympic sports bodies to end a three-year program vetting Russians for neutral status ahead of qualifying events for the 2028 LA Olympics.
